records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up on your bulk-import question from last week -- teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and your ticket on that is now closed, so just say the word if anything there is still unclear.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, getting that first one in place is usually the quickest way to see whether Wrenfield fits how Silver Logistics works.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up your first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
